title: Two EC2 Instances in Same VPC Cannot Communicate
symptom: Instance A cannot reach Instance B on internal private IP (`ping 10.0.2.15` fails or times out).
initial_observations: Both instances are in the same VPC but different subnets.
Local OS firewall or Security Group drops traffic.

possible_causes.cause: Instance B Security Group does not allow traffic from Instance A Security Group
possible_causes.evidence_needed: Security Group B ingress rules do not reference SG A or Subnet A CIDR.
possible_causes.remediation: Add ingress rule in SG B allowing desired protocol/port from SG A.

investigation_steps.title: Check Security Group Rules on Both Instances
investigation_steps.explanation: Verify ingress on target instance allows source instance.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Missing rule for ICMP or TCP port.

verification: Ping or curl from Instance A to Instance B succeeds.
prevention: Use VPC-wide internal security group allowing internal communication where required.
